name: the-copy-link-hint-names-its-hotkey
description: The floating address bar's copy link button (.dvcopy) hovers to a hint naming Cmd+Shift+C, the key IsCopyLinkKeyEquivalent matches on the raw NSEvent. That chord is never registered with NativeHotkeyMap, so bindingFor has nothing to return for it - the key comes from a FALLBACK_KEYS entry, the same table sbback/sbfwd/sbreload use for their own unregistered Chromium accelerators. This run hovers the button and reads the hint's label and key off the shared overlay.

actions.note: ssh-launched Atrium is not frontmost on a clean snapshot
Developer Mode: brings up the floating address bar with the copy link button

actions.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.dvcopy'); if (!b) { return 'no-button'; } b.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerover', {bubbles: true})); return 'hovered'; })()

actions.note: the devbar route sends this through chrome.send to HintOverlayWidget's own /hint document

assertions.desc: the devbar came up with its copy link button
the copy link button was found and hovered
The hint carries the button's label
The hint names Cmd+Shift+C, the key IsCopyLinkKeyEquivalent actually dispatches
